env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent skims section summaries and extracts details only from task-relevant regions, keeping prompts small.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we provide the LLM with the extracted outputs from all selected sections and prompt it to generate a compact page summary
context_compaction.note: Observations are summarized into one paragraph and appended to the history. Only selected sections are extracted.

observation_format.evidence_quote: prompt it to generate a compact page summary ˆot, which becomes the observation passed to the action module
observation_format.note: Images are captioned by a VLM into text.
